selection_rule.population: The exact archived 140 NEW same-AA pairs, with OWN fresh eligibility; no new pair or sign selection
selection_rule.correct: signed helix readout minus signed strand readout > 0
selection_rule.tie: difference == 0 receives 0.5 paired credit and is excluded from correctly judged candidates
selection_rule.median_population: All 122 strictly correct pairs among the frozen 140, before any length restriction
selection_rule.median_operation: Ordinary sample median, average of the central two ordered values for even n
selection_rule.author_length_revision: The upper bound was relaxed from 250 to 275 because no correctly ordered pair had a full input length <=250; author selected Q9I398 after reviewing this fact
selection_rule.length_definition: len(canonical UniProt sequence) exactly as supplied unmasked to the original model; not the PDB construct or observed-coordinate length
selection_rule.criterion: Minimize absolute distance from the all-correct median, among correct pairs satisfying the length bound
selection_rule.exact_tie_break: Ascending zero-based data-row order in the original frozen inputs/pairs.tsv (header excluded)
selection_rule.selection_timing: Author-requested post hoc illustrative selection; does not alter any frozen evaluation result

readout_definition.index_basis: block0=19 indexes model.model.layers[19] (20th layer); unit0=1900 indexes the hidden tensor [...,1900] directly with zero-based Python indexing. The project label 'channel 1900' is retained as an identifier, not renumbered to 1901
readout_definition.sign_source: E1_F_IDENTITY_REPLAY.json identities['1900'].sign_helix_vs_beta=+1, fixed before current T/NEW scoring; the separate helix-start concept uses -1 and is not this readout
readout_definition.scale: Native post-SwiGLU channel amplitude; no sigmoid, softmax, or probability calibration
readout_definition.context: Full original canonical sequence, batch size one; two prefix tokens excluded from residue indexing
readout_definition.observation: E1 layer 19 ffn.mlp.w2 forward-pre-hook input: post-SwiGLU hidden channel, before output projection
readout_definition.dtype: Archived float32 values, converted losslessly to Python float for JSON

annotation_definition.strand: Frozen negative0: UniProt Beta strand intersected with the archived clean observed-residue domain
annotation_definition.other: Neither frozen positive0 nor negative0; includes non-helix/strand positions and positions excluded from the test domain; does not imply experimentally verified coil
annotation_definition.physical_secondary: Separate archived P-SEA annotation from Biotite (H/E/C); not used to replace the frozen UniProt test label
annotation_definition.disagreement_policy: Preserve both annotations if they disagree
